en.headline: Consumer Council reports nearly 2705 customer service complaints this year
en.dek: The figure up to August approaches last year’s full-year total, with common issues including no follow-up, uncontactable service and slow responses; the Council notes AI tools can help but often need human backup.
body: The Consumer Council said it received 2,705 complaints related to merchants’ customer service from January to August this year, a figure that approaches the total for the whole of last year.

The Council said the numbers reflect a gap between service quality and consumer expectations. Common problems included merchants failing to follow up, customers being unable to contact service staff, rude treatment and slow responses.

In one case cited by the Council, a consumer booked tickets through an online platform and was told by the company’s AI chatbot that the tickets could be rescheduled if a tropical cyclone signal was raised. When the signal was issued on the event day, the AI system could not process the change and subsequent calls and emails went unanswered for days.

The Council said artificial intelligence tools can improve the efficiency of enquiries and complaint handling, but when consumers need further assistance, AI may not fully understand their needs and human customer service support is still often required.

zh.headline: 消委會今年接獲近2705宗客戶服務投訴 逼近去年全年數字
zh.dek: 截至8月的數字已接近去年全年總數，常見問題包括無人跟進、聯絡不到及跟進緩慢；消委會指人工智能有助提升效率，但仍需真人支援。
body: 消費者委員會表示，今年1月至8月接獲2705宗有關商戶客戶服務的投訴，數字已逼近去年全年接獲的個案總數。
消委會指，數據反映商戶客戶服務質素與消費者期望存在落差。常見問題包括商戶「無人跟進」、客服「聯絡不到」、「無禮貌」及「跟進緩慢」等。
消委會引述一宗個案，投訴人透過網上平台預訂活動門票，公司人工智能客服回覆指如懸掛熱帶氣旋信號可改期。活動當日天文台發出八號烈風或暴風信號後，人工智能系統無法處理改期要求，其後致電及電郵多日無人回應。
消委會表示，人工智能應用有助提升查詢及投訴處理效率，但當消費者需要進一步協助時，人工智能未必能完全理解需要，仍可能需要真人客服支援。
